title: Sherwood H Smith Jr energy complex
extract: Sherwood H Smith Jr energy complex is an operating power station of at least 2243-megawatts (MW) in Hamlet, Richmond, North Carolina, United States with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating. It is also known as Smith Energy Complex.
